limitations: Finite provider admission, explicit policy authority, FIFO reread, remote grant settlement and conditional storage commit are modeled. The queue, CAS and filesystem fencing rely on their separate source-linked models.

Two calls, two roots, one replace/delete/reset and bounded logical time. Request deadlines model fair abort of provider/header/body I/O; storage calls still must settle for progress. Real process/HTTP scenarios establish selected paths, not exhaustive refinement.

Provider enrollment, unbounded retry/restart, pool health/account eviction and external cryptography remain outside this projection. A failed or malformed response may have consumed the remote grant; the API must not fabricate persistence or promise automatic recovery.
